title: About
intro: I'm Erin McKinnon. I'm the person you call when something has to get done and done right.
body:
My path here wasn't a straight line. I started in ballet and the performing arts, studied at NYU and UCF, and spent years in modeling and pageants before finding my way into experiential marketing. It turns out all of it was training for the same thing: showing up prepared, reading a room, and delivering under pressure when the lights come on.

I built a long career in promotional staffing and brand activations, with deep ties to spirits brands like Heineken, Proximo, Beam Suntory, and Jägermeister. I lead National Talent & Field Operations at Michele & Group: talent booking, program setup, and activation logistics for programs that run hundreds of events at a time, and I designed the Airtable system the agency runs on.

Along the way I learned that I love the part most people avoid: the structure. The booking system, the run of show, the volunteer database, the recap that turns a weekend of events into a story a client can take upstairs. So I founded Manage the Event to bring that to everything else I care about.

Alongside Michele & Group, that means planning events and building systems for the 13 Ugly Men Foundation, serving on the Tampa Heights Civic Association board, and taking on projects for brands and organizations that need someone to own the details.

Tampa is home. I want to be the person this city's companies, nonprofits, and campaigns call when it matters: “Call Erin. She'll get it handled.”
highlights: National Talent & Field Operations, Michele & Group (talent booking, program setup, activation logistics)
Events, board coordination, and tech systems, 13 Ugly Men Foundation
Board member, Tampa Heights Civic Association
Airtable builder: Twilio, SendGrid, Front, MiniExtensions, Google Sheets, APIs
Background: ballet and performing arts, NYU and UCF
